# EditWitness

> Local, inspectable CRISPR assay counterexamples and follow-up panel comparisons.

Research alpha 0.2.0a1. Software-tested; not empirically biologically validated.
No API key, network calls, LLM dependency or safety certification.

## Entry points
- [README](README.md): purpose, source installation and runnable synthetic examples.
- [Scientific model](docs/scientific-model.md): exact-v2 and legacy-v1 assumptions.
- [Agent guide](docs/agent-guide.md): machine contract and safe interpretation.
- [Data contract](docs/data-contract.md): coordinates, signal sets and exit codes.
- [Audit](docs/audit-0.2.0a1.md): substantive findings, fixes and limits.
- [Build evidence](BUILD_STATUS.md): measured checks and actual publication status.
- [Roadmap](roadmap.json): tasks, acceptance criteria and uncompleted validation.

Use `editwitness capabilities`, `schema manifest`, `validate`, `analyze --compact`,
`witness --include-sequences`, `expand-deletions`, and `compare-models`.
Never turn no witnesses into proof of a safe edit or grid counts into risk.
